leakage_finding: MAJOR: DiffDock-PP was trained on DIPS, and 141/150 (94%) of the samples in our original phase_d_bin_* test bins are in DiffDock-PP's training split. Pretrained DiffDock-PP eval on those bins is invalid.

symmetric_leakage_our_train_in_dpp_test.note: Our pretrained checkpoints saw some of DiffDock-PP's test set during training. Naive 'evaluate ours on DPP-test' is also tainted; we need to filter.

remediation.approach: Build a NEW evaluation set: DiffDock-PP-test MINUS our train union. Both pretrained models can be fairly evaluated on the result.
remediation.decision: Cap each bin at 30 samples (random.seed=42) for parity with the original bins and DiffDock-PP inference tractability. Stored as benchmarks/splits/clean_{bin}.json. The le200 bin has only 1 clean sample — not statistically meaningful; we'll report it as a footnote, not headline.
